title: Deep Claim component diagram
description: Deep Claim, an asteroid-mining platformer: the Godot game runs entirely in the browser, and the Worker only checks the sign-in and serves the files.

components.name: Deep Claim
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot client and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Godot game
components.responsibility: Everything the player sees and does: shafts, the miner, the buggy, oxygen and fuel, the collapse timer, hazards, HUD, sound and touch buttons.

components.name: Web page
components.responsibility: The page the web export runs in (godot/web_shell/shell.html) and its loading screen, script, styles and Content-Security-Policy (web/).

components.name: Worker
components.responsibility: Sends a visitor without a sign-in to sign in, serves the page and assets, and joins the engine's parts into one index.wasm.

components.name: Shaft-map builder
components.responsibility: Writes the twenty shaft maps into godot/scripts/levels.gd and checks that every ore can be reached from the buggy's lane.

components.name: icelander-auth
components.responsibility: icelander.net's shared sign-in library, copied into vendor/; asks the login service who holds the site_session cookie.

relationships.description: Exported for the web by build.mjs into dist/games/retro/deep-claim/.
Copied into the export by build.mjs.
boot.js starts the engine with the export's configuration.
